The success path: VALIDATING_FILES -> QUEUED -> RUNNING -> SUCCEEDED, then a
readiness probe (GET /v1/models/{id}) that answers 200 — the model is
registered and invocable, so Deploy reports Ready true with a non-zero
ReadyAt. OpenAI's job-status vocabulary has no DEPLOYING state (unlike
Together's dedicated endpoint), which is why this sequence is four polls,
not five.
